sourceConcepts: Williams Alligator + MACD + Parabolic SAR confirmation
Market structure + supply/demand + liquidity sweep + conservative market shift

entry.alligator: SMMA 5 > 8 > 13, all three rising, spread widening
entry.runtimeHigherTimeframe: actual Binance 4h close above rising EMA20
entry.demandZone: previous bearish pivot candle before bullish displacement >=0.8 ATR and relvol >=1.10; expires after 96 bars or a close below the zone low
entry.liquiditySweep: take prior 12-bar low, reclaim it, and interact with pre-existing demand
entry.marketShift: close above prior 12-bar high within 8 bars after sweep
entry.location: entry within 3 ATR above valid demand-zone top
entry.minimumRoom: known overhead 48-bar liquidity must allow >=2R, unless price already broke it

risk.structureStop: 0.20 ATR below the lower of demand-zone low or swept-liquidity low
risk.positionSizing: shrink notional when structural stop would exceed maxRiskUSDT

notes: This is an implemented mechanical translation of the source concepts, not a claim that the source strategy is profitable.
Real-money execution stays disabled until the existing validator/forward gates and explicit user enable condition are satisfied.
